ghi_chu: Chụp lại ở hàng s03-len-cong: Stage A và B loại tin cấp thị trường, nên có thêm hằng KHONG_CAP_THI_TRUONG. Bản đầu chụp từ 82a53e0a, 9 câu. Chụp lại ở hàng dong-bang-stage-b-resolve (V7): bỏ ba câu Stage B (xoá cặp chờ, dựng cặp, đếm needs_llm) — 7 câu. Chụp lại ở hàng resolve-stage-a-theo-tap (15/11): Stage A chạy theo tập qua hai bảng tạm của phiên thay vòng mỗi cụm — 12 câu (câu DROP bảng tạm xuất hiện hai lần, đầu và cuối).
cau: floor(s.latitude / 0.0005)::text || '|' || floor(s.longitude / 0.0005)::text || '|' || o.kind || '|' || COALESCE(o.property_type, '?') || '|' || round(o.area_m2)::text || '|' || round(o.price_vnd / 1e6)::text
NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM areas x WHERE x.id = o.area_id AND x.region_type = 'market')
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp.stage_a_tin, pg_temp.stage_a_cum

CREATE TEMP TABLE stage_a_tin AS SELECT o.offer_id, o.area_id, o.kind, o.property_type, o.first_seen, o.last_seen, s.latitude, s.longitude, ${CLUSTER_EXPR} AS cluster_key, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM property_offers po WHERE po.offer_id = o.offer_id) AS chua_gan FROM sale_offers o JOIN stg_chotot_ads s ON o.offer_id = 'offer_' || substr(encode(digest('S06|' || s.list_id::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'), 1, 16) WHERE o.source = 'S06' AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND o.area_m2 IS NOT NULL AND o.price_vnd > 0 AND ${KHONG_CAP_THI_TRUONG}

CREATE TEMP TABLE stage_a_cum AS SELECT cluster_key, count(*)::int n, date_trunc('milliseconds', min(first_seen)) fs, date_trunc('milliseconds', max(last_seen)) ls, (array_agg(area_id ORDER BY last_seen DESC))[1] area_id, (array_agg(kind ORDER BY last_seen DESC))[1] kind, (array_agg(property_type ORDER BY last_seen DESC))[1] pt, round(avg(latitude)::numeric, 6) lat, round(avg(longitude)::numeric, 6) lng, count(*) FILTER (WHERE chua_gan)::int n_chua_gan, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM properties p WHERE p.stable_key = t.cluster_key) co_can FROM stage_a_tin t GROUP BY cluster_key

SELECT count(*)::int n_cum, count(*) FILTER (WHERE co_can)::int n_khop, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT co_can AND n_chua_gan > 0)::int n_moi, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT co_can AND n_chua_gan = 0)::int n_bo_qua, COALESCE(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE co_can OR n_chua_gan > 0), 0)::int n_evidence FROM stage_a_cum
UPDATE properties p SET last_seen = GREATEST(p.last_seen, c.ls), n_evidence = c.n FROM stage_a_cum c WHERE c.co_can AND p.stable_key = c.cluster_key

INSERT INTO properties (geo, area_id, property_type, kind, cluster_key, stable_key, n_evidence, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_by, verification) SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(c.lng, c.lat), 4326)::geography, c.area_id, c.pt, c.kind, c.cluster_key, c.cluster_key, c.n, c.fs, c.ls, 'stage-ab', 'pending' FROM stage_a_cum c WHERE NOT c.co_can AND c.n_chua_gan > 0 ORDER BY c.cluster_key

INSERT INTO property_offers (property_id, offer_id, score, signals) SELECT p.id, t.offer_id, 1.0, '{"geo":1,"price":1,"area":1}'::jsonb FROM stage_a_tin t JOIN stage_a_cum c ON c.cluster_key = t.cluster_key AND (c.co_can OR c.n_chua_gan > 0) JOIN properties p ON p.stable_key = t.cluster_key WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM property_offers po WHERE po.offer_id = t.offer_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp.stage_a_tin, pg_temp.stage_a_cum
